title: PowerToys Run Calculator Click to 'Copy this number to clipboard' fails, with error dialogue
author: robfromnz

status.label: Existing upstream fix
status.detail: PR 51197 targets Calculator's post-write OLE flush failure.

next_action.label: Review PR 51197
next_action.reason: Do not duplicate the targeted clipboard implementation or repeat already-supplied diagnostic requests.

judgment.rationale: Open PR 51197 explicitly fixes this issue and targets the partial-success path documented in the discussion. It does not establish that every environment-specific clipboard failure is solved.
evidence: The discussion supplies numerous diagnostic archives, CLIPBRD_E_CANT_OPEN/Clipboard.Flush observations, and reports that text is copied despite a failure dialog.

October 2025 comments supply a repeatable small-text versus large-file clipboard comparison; reports both with and without particular remote-control/Logitech software rule out a universal single-app explanation.
The inspected Calculator ResultHelper.cs calls WPF Clipboard.SetText.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51197 is OPEN, explicitly fixes 25437, and replaces Calculator's WPF persistence path with a scoped native clipboard helper.
judgment.recommended_action: Review the existing PR and retain verification of the large-file and real-contention scenarios; no competing fix or generic log request.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR 51197 covers the post-write OLE flush failure and preserves handling for genuine initial lock failure. The PR explicitly does not claim installed reproduction of every large-file report.

issue_context.summary: Calculator copying may pause and report an error even when the result reaches the clipboard. An open targeted PR removes the post-write OLE flush from that plugin.
known_information: The original report includes freeze/error screenshots and later comments include diagnostics.
The full 58-comment discussion distinguishes temporary clipboard contention, copied-despite-error behavior, and large existing clipboard content.
PR 51197 is open and includes native clipboard ownership/persistence tests.
inferences: Some reports are consistent with successful text publication followed by a failing persistence phase.
Other initial-lock or remote-software scenarios may require separate validation; one clipboard mechanism must not be asserted for every report.
issue_context.analysis: There is enough supplied public context to review a concrete implementation. Requesting another generic ZIP or inventing a competing plan would not advance this issue.
initial_investigation: Read the complete body, all comments, and paginated linked-work timeline.
Inspected Calculator's Clipboard.SetText call and read PR 51197's full scope, verification claims, limitations, and changed-file list.
Recorded the linked dotnet/wpf issue 9901 as related external context, not proof that PowerToys has no applicable correction.
